funding.name: SkillUp NJ: Free online learning
funding.provider: New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development
funding.provides: Gives New Jersey workers, employed or unemployed, free access to more than 5,000 Skillsoft online courses, including industry-recognized certifications.
funding.eligibility: New Jersey workers, whether or not currently unemployed, per the page.
funding.how_to_apply: Access through the SkillUp New Jersey training program.

funding.name: NJ Apprenticeship: Become an apprentice
funding.provider: New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development, Office of Apprenticeship
funding.provides: Explains that registered apprenticeship combines paid on-the-job learning with classroom instruction so apprentices earn money while building skills.

funding.name: NJ Apprenticeship career seekers page
funding.provider: New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development, Office of Apprenticeship
funding.provides: NJ Office of Apprenticeship page for career seekers, stating that apprenticeships are available beyond the construction trades.

funding.name: NJ Trade Adjustment Assistance (TAA)
funding.provider: New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development
funding.provides: Describes TAA services for adversely affected workers; the page states the federal TAA program expired June 30, 2022, and workers certified and separated on or before that date may still be eligible.
funding.eligibility: Workers certified from a petition and separated from their job on or before June 30, 2022.

funding.name: Upskill NJ Incumbent Worker Training
funding.provider: New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development
funding.provides: Training grants that let New Jersey employers, unions and community organizations upskill existing employees.
funding.eligibility: New Jersey employers (labor unions, businesses, community organizations).
funding.amount: Up to $2,000 per worker, per the page.

funding.name: NJ Apprenticeship Start-Up Tax Credit
funding.provider: New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development and Division of Taxation
funding.provides: Tax credit for taxpayers with documented start-up costs for the first year of a registered apprenticeship program, administered through the Apprenticeship Start-Up Grant Program.
funding.eligibility: Taxpayers with documented qualified start-up costs for an approved apprenticeship program.
funding.how_to_apply: Apply to the Department of Labor, which forwards approval to the Division of Taxation.
